subject: RE: Urgent: Production incident -> capacity & deployment options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@finovo.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + urgent capacity note

Hi Jordan / Anita —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Current ask: you said the search-ranking feature will go live to a subset of users next week and you expect ~3–5x traffic uplift during the promo window.
- Qualification: you mentioned needing strong latency (p95 < 200ms) and predictable per-token costs. Also noted potential compliance/PII constraints for some payloads.

Two things I want to call out as we evaluate deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC):
1) If traffic and latency requirements are steady and predictable, Dedicated reserved capacity is typically the right fit (predictable SLOs, isolation).
2) If you have regulatory/PII constraints or need customer-managed networking, Private (VPC/on-prem) is the option — longer lead time.

Separately, I heard from our infra team that you actually experienced a spike this morning that caused elevated error rates on the Hosted API demo — I wanted to flag that and offer immediate mitigations while we decide longer-term.

Next steps I propose:
- Please confirm expected peak RPS and whether the traffic includes PII.
- I'll pull initial traffic logs and loop in Rishi (SE) to scope an immediate buffer (burst quota) + a Dedicated sizing estimate.
- If you think Private is required, we should start procurement and security assessment this week (longer lead time).

Can you confirm availability for a 1-hour tech deep-dive tomorrow (Mar 31)?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@finovo.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Confirming a few things from our side:
- We did see the spike this morning — error rate shot up to ~8% for generation calls and latency spiked to p95 ~1.2s. That impacted live search quality for a tranche of users.
- Peak: we expect baseline 350 QPS and the promo could add bursts to ~1,200 QPS for short windows (5–10 min) over the next 7–10 days.
- Data sensitivity: some payloads include customer PII (names/email) in the prompt; can't be sent to unmanaged environments for certain customers. We need a solution that guarantees data residency/controls for a subset of traffic.

Given the incident and the compliance constraints, we're evaluating immediate steps to avoid more outages. What's realistic for an emergency mitigation vs a Dedicated or Private rollout? Also need high-level cost ballpark ASAP so I can brief procurement.

Jordan
VP, Product
Finovo
jordan.mills@finovo.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@finovo.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + urgent capacity note

Hi Jordan — looping in as SE. Quick technical notes after a first pass on the logs you forwarded (see attached traffic-logs-20260330.csv):

- Root cause: combination of a sudden traffic spike + aggressive batching timeouts on the demo flow leading to queue saturation. We also saw several large-context prompts that increase per-token compute.
- Short-term mitigation (hours): we can push a temporary burst allocation on Hosted to cover short spikes (configurable for 24–72 hours), and adjust batching settings to reduce queue timeouts.
- Mid-term (days): Dedicated reserved cluster gives you guaranteed capacity and isolation — we can size based on the peak numbers you provided; typical lead time to provision (hosted Dedicated pool) is ~10–14 business days depending on GPU availability.
- Private/VPC (weeks): if you require customer-managed networking or strict data residency for PII, Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) is recommended — estimated 6–8 weeks including security review and provisioning.

Questions for you:
1) Which portion of traffic must remain in-managed (i.e., cannot touch Hosted)? % split would help.
2) Do you have procurement timelines or PO constraints we should be aware of?

I'll push initial performance numbers and a rough cost estimate in a follow-up within 24 hours.

— Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -07:00

Thanks Rishi — quick answers from security/procurement:

- Data split: ~60% of requests are non-PII and are fine to remain on Hosted; ~40% must remain in a customer-managed environment.
- Procurement: we can push for an expedited PO but will need firm timelines and an initial cost estimate to get internal approval.
- Preference: if Dedicated can meet isolation + guaranteed performance for the 40% (and we can route PII there), that would be preferred to moving fully to Private. Private is an option if Dedicated can't satisfy data controls.

Can you provide:
- Dedicated sizing + provisional pricing today
- Private/VPC rough lead time and cost delta

Anita
Head of Engineering Operations | Finovo
anita.shah@finovo.com

Subject: Next steps: immediate mitigation + Dedicated/Private options

Jordan / Anita — thanks for the quick replies. Summarizing action items and timeline so we have a clear path forward:

Immediate (same day):
- Redwood ops (Rishi) to enable a temporary hosted burst allocation for the next 72 hours to prevent further outages.
- We'll grant a one-time credit for overage during the promo window (details to finance).

Short-term (next 24–72 hours):
- Rishi to send a Dedicated sizing + provisional pricing doc (based on 1,200 QPS bursting) — expected within 24 hours.
- If Dedicated meets the isolation requirements for the 40% PII traffic (via routing and tenant isolation), we'll proceed with Dedicated as the default path to stabilize production.

Mid-term (2–8 weeks):
- Dedicated provisioning target: 10–14 business days after signed commit.
- Private/VPC target: 6–8 weeks including security review and network setup.

Confirming asks for you so we can prioritize:
1) Please confirm % of traffic that must be customer-managed (Anita said ~40%) — if that holds, we'll size Dedicated to host both workloads with routing, otherwise we can start Private assessment in parallel.
2) Can you confirm procurement timeline / PO window?

I'll schedule the 1-hour tech deep-dive for Wed Mar 31 10:00 PT unless you confirm a different time.

Thanks — we'll get this stabilized.

Best,
